assets.prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Asset type: SynapseGit repository social-preview graphic. Refresh the supplied existing social card with crisp, polished image quality and accurate modern product semantics. Retain its clean 2:1 composition, ivory background, left-aligned large dark forest-green product title, refined sans-serif typography, and restrained sage, purple and amber palette. Exact left text: "SynapseGit" and on the next line "Creative-work provenance, locally". Exact small status label: "Release candidate". On the right, replace the old branching conceptual diagram with a simple clear left-to-right flow of three rounded nodes connected by arrows: "AI proposal" (purple), "Human decision" (amber), "Local archive" (forest green). A small picture-file symbol may introduce the flow; retain the quiet spacious feel and legibility at thumbnail size. The arrows must visibly go from AI proposal to Human decision to Local archive; no bypass from AI to archive, no parallel AI and human authorization, no cloud or remote publish. This is an explanatory concept graphic, not an app screenshot. No fictional UI controls, hash strings, additional text, logos from other brands, people, or watermark. Render every quoted label verbatim with clean readable lettering. Output a PNG in exactly 1280x640 if possible, 2:1 landscape.
